visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman are seen in a close-up selfie shot, posing and smiling at the camera with their hands on their chins. A small circular inset video at the top shows a different couple performing a workout move. (2) The scene cuts to a wider shot in a bright indoor room with a red plastic slide in the background. The man, wearing a purple tank top and black pants, is standing over the woman, who is lying on her back on a floor mat, wearing a grey hoodie and plaid pants. They are attempting to recreate the workout move from the previous phase. (3) The camera captures multiple quick-cut attempts where the man lifts the woman's legs. They are both smiling and laughing during the physical exertion. (4) In the final phase, the woman is lying on her side on the mat, clutching her neck with a pained expression. The man is nearby, laughing. Purple and white text overlays appear on the screen indicating she hurt her neck. (5) The screen fades to black with the centered text 'hurt my neck' in purple.
